Can be used to report the type of a file, if the file is in
a format known to AMPS.

Can be used to search and extract information from
the AMPS error and event log or AMPS journal files.

Can be used to examine the contents of an AMPS
journal file during troubleshooting, debugging and
program tuning.

Can be used to find the transaction log record for a
specific bookmark or transaction ID.

Can be used to inspect the contents of a SOW topic
store.

Can be used to inspect the contents of an AMPS
clients acknowledgment file.

Can be used to inspect the contents of an AMPS
queues acknowledgment file.

Can be used to inspect the contents of an AMPS
journal topic index.
